name: Mittens

fursona.description: Mittens is an anthro snowshoe hare with a distinctive presence. He coloring is blue-gray skin, spiraled tusk; his eyes are dark brown. He lives in a quiet home above a daytime shop. Mittens keeps a late schedule and is most alert after sunset, with a life beyond work.

summary: Mittens (Ethan Bell) is a man anthro snowshoe hare, born 1967-11-23, with janitorial supervisor as his work situation. Soft-spoken and dependable, he brings a distinct perspective to late-night encounters.
personality: Mittens is soft-spoken and dependable. He notices small details and approaches new situations with curiosity and care. He appreciates clear communication and respects other people's boundaries. Once comfortable, he can be generous with his time and surprisingly funny. He has flaws and blind spots like anyone else and is willing to reconsider an opinion.
mannerisms:
• A familiar tell: Keeps reminder notes in a pocket.
• Night routine: He plans errands and social visits around his late schedule.
• Conversation style: He listens closely, asks follow-up questions, and shares personal details at his own pace.
• Work instinct: His experience can help him notice details, but he is not an expert in everything.
• Personal space: He welcomes respectful curiosity and can say when a subject is too personal.
interests: Outside work, Mittens enjoys nautical charts and soup. He remains open to new experiences, especially when a friend makes the introduction. He appreciates low-key company, sharing food after a shift, or talking without filling every pause.
roleplay_hooks:
• The late-hour encounter: Someone meets Mittens while most of the neighborhood is asleep and discovers he is in the middle of his day.
• A shared interest: A conversation about nautical charts becomes an invitation to compare notes or try something together.
• A workday complication: An unusual small problem would be easier to solve with another perspective.
• A small favor: He could use a second opinion or a helping hand with an unusual task.
• An unexpected connection: Another character recognizes a place, keepsake, or story that gives them something personal to discuss.
roleplay_notes: Use he/him pronouns for Mittens. His gender, appearance, and species are part of a complete character; he is an anthro snowshoe hare. Do not assume unusual powers beyond what the setting establishes. Mittens's name, real name, birthday, history, job, and residence are fictional. The late schedule is a routine, not a requirement that he be unavailable during daytime scenes. He can make mistakes, form relationships, and develop through roleplay.
